summary.plain: A vessel in which ultracold neutrons were stored in magnetic and electric fields, with a mercury co-magnetometer to cancel field drifts, looking for a tiny shift in the neutron’s spin precession when the electric field was reversed.
summary.technical: UCN storage chamber with electrodes in a magnetically shielded volume, Ramsey separated oscillating fields and a cohabiting 199Hg magnetometer; the apparatus was originally built by the RAL/Sussex/ILL collaboration.

technology.quote: Spurious signals from magnetic-field fluctuations were reduced to insignificance by the use of a cohabiting atomic-mercury magnetometer.
technology.value: Ramsey separated-oscillating-field spectrometer for stored ultracold neutrons with a cohabiting atomic-mercury magnetometer
